title: Base Power header
description: A fixed top bar: heavy lowercase wordmark, a row of nav items with chevrons, a hairline log-in button and a lime sign-up button. Clear with light ink over the photo hero, it turns into a solid white bar with dark ink and a forest log-in outline over the first 80px of scrolling. Nav items get a stone pill and a flipping chevron on hover; phones get a burger menu.
notes: fixed and clear at the top: put a dark photo hero under it (the next block should start under the bar)
the solid look scrubs in with a CSS scroll timeline; without support, or with reduced motion, it is always solid
chevron items keep the hover look but open no menu; the phone menu is a <details> disclosure (no JavaScript)
